sections.markdown:
## F — Driving records, suspensions and reinstatement
Research index: 28 original C facts and 16 continuation or confusable C2 facts cover Driving records, suspensions and reinstatement.
Exam index: part A cites cover edition, publisher frontmatter and the physical testing page; no passing percentage or time limit is asserted.
VERIFY: ID-RECORD-PERCENT — official percentage not printed; ID-RECORD-TIME — official time limit unlocated; ID-RECORD-EFFECTIVE — effective date unestablished.
VERIFY: ID-RECORD-DYNAMIC — Current statutes, fee schedules, course approvals, office channels, interlock rules and court procedures need legal and currency verification before release.
VERIFY: ID-RECORD-MARKET — demand research missing; ID-RECORD-COMPETITORS — competitor research missing.
Every open item stays assigned to the evidence or research owner in its originating chunk. Pedagogic priorities are not official topic weights.
VERIFY: ID-RECORD-LEGAL-CURRENCY — All driving-record, point, GDL and suspension consequences in these mapped pages are source descriptions from the staged handbook. Current statutory scope, exceptions and amendments have not passed the reserved legal review; current-law release remains blocked.
VERIFY: ID-TSC-COMPLETION-SPAN — The Traffic Safety Education Course rule begins on physical page one hundred twenty-three and continues onto one hundred twenty-four. Its full conditions include a maximum four-point reduction, an officer's offer and driver acceptance at citation, completion within forty-five days and removal tied to that citation's points. The complete multi-page rule is withheld rather than omitting its deadline.
VERIFY: ID-POINT-COURSE-ACCESS — The handbook's approved-course website, contact number and current local Traffic Safety Education Course availability were not checked. No present approval, provider access or appointment is promised.
VERIFY: ID-ALS-REFUSAL-INTERLOCK-REVIEW — The ALS, refusal, court-review and interlock rules on physical pages one hundred twenty-five through one hundred twenty-seven need current legal verification, including the blanket all-ALS interlock wording and interaction with absolute suspensions. Source conditions are preserved; no broader eligibility is inferred.
VERIFY: ID-REINSTATEMENT-CONTINUATION — The reinstatement paragraph on physical page one hundred twenty-seven ends mid-sentence and continues onto one hundred twenty-eight. Applying and paying source-described fees do not constitute a complete reinstatement checklist; the continuation needs a supported multi-page binding.
VERIFY: ID-REINSTATEMENT-FEE-CURRENCY — The handbook's twenty-five-through-two-hundred-eighty-five-dollar reinstatement range and possible multiple fees are not verified against a current official schedule. Do not quote a current payable amount or guarantee restoration from payment alone.

corpus_stability.reason: Corpus is the frozen July handbook snapshot; future issuer changes require a new source registration, rather than silent updates to this corpus.
